mapper.sql: version_id, item_key, content_hash, record_type, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, parent_signal_id, intent, structure, expiry_date, status_code, result_kind, settled_day, issued_day, pnl_usd, emitted_time, emitted_time_utc, settled_time, settled_time_utc, sort_no, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark

select sync_id, feed_sync_id, feed_result, market_day, result, record_count, midterm_count, card_count, stat_count, settled_count, settled_pnl_usd, raw_pnl_usd, protection_cost_usd, manage_cost_usd, manage_credit_usd, new_version_count, changed_kinds, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc from option_settlement_sync
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (item_key, content_hash, record_type, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, parent_signal_id, intent, structure, expiry_date, status_code, result_kind, settled_day, issued_day, pnl_usd, emitted_time, emitted_time_utc, settled_time, settled_time_utc, sort_no, payload, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark) values (#{item.itemKey}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.recordType}, #{item.symbol}, #{item.signalId}, #{item.recommendationId}, #{item.parentSignalId}, #{item.intent}, #{item.structure}, #{item.expiryDate}, #{item.statusCode}, #{item.resultKind}, #{item.settledDay}, #{item.issuedDay}, #{item.pnlUsd}, #{item.emittedTime}, date_sub(#{item.emittedTime}, interval 8 hour), #{item.settledTime}, date_sub(#{item.settledTime}, interval 8 hour), #{item.sortNo}, #{item.payload}, #{item.firstSyncId}, #{item.lastSyncId}, #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.remark})

insert into option_settlement_sync (feed_sync_id, feed_result, market_day, result, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc) values (#{feedSyncId}, #{feedResult}, #{marketDay}, #{result}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp())
mapper.select: where result = 'UPDATED' order by sync_id desc limit 1
